This topic is part of the Cambridge IGCSE GCSE Physics specification.

Nuclear Physics appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

The Cambridge IGCSE board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Nuclear Physics.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
